SELECT b.oid, b.typarray
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_type a
      LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type b ON b.oid = a.typelem
      WHERE a.typcategory = 'A'
      GROUP BY b.oid, b.typarray
      ORDER BY b.oid

select l.*,jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'content',r.content,'tags',r.tags,'published',r.published) recipe_documents from public.recipe_library_entries l join public.recipe_documents r on r.id=l.recipe_id order by l.updated_at desc
